title: 1944 press reports of silver spheres over Germany

tellings.quote: there's a whole bunch of stories in 1944 Newsweek ran the silver sphere sp puzzle um Christmas day in 1944 Associated Press balls of silver scene over the German Reich intrigue science

plain: In 1944, during the Second World War, the press reported strange silver balls seen in the sky over Germany. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff points to two of these reports: a Newsweek article from 1944 called "The Silver Sphere Puzzle", and an Associated Press news wire story from Christmas Day 1944 headlined "Balls of silver seen over the German Reich intrigue science." He brings them up to show that odd objects were being reported in the papers years before the modern UFO era.
